authority: ERPNext remains authoritative for financial transactions, inventory mutations, permissions and pricing

parameters.warehouse: required non-group enabled Warehouse readable by the user
parameters.price_list: required enabled selling Price List readable by the user
parameters.state: optional JSON sync token/state previously returned by server
parameters.customer: optional readable Customer for customer-specific pricing

response.reset: boolean; true on schema/scope/permission/staleness/date boundary mismatch
response.complete: false when active catalog exceeds safety cap

securityInvariants: Only public counter fields are returned; supplier, purchase-rate, cost and valuation fields are excluded
Permission-restricted deployments force reset instead of leaking item-code tombstones
Deltas intentionally overlap by 10 seconds and are idempotent
Rates/quantities are advisory snapshots; submission revalidates in ERPNext

response.items: public item rows ranked exact barcode, prefix, then substring

securityInvariants: Searchable field allowlist is name/item_code/item_name/item_group/brand plus barcodes
Permission filtering is applied before public rows are returned
Client-side ranking must preserve exact barcode then prefix then substring ordering

parameters.override_rate: requires explicit Sales Invoice write permission

securityInvariants: ERPNext creates and submits the Sales Invoice
Client-supplied rates are ignored unless override_rate is authorized
Idempotency keys bind to canonical request fingerprints
Concurrent replays never create duplicate financial documents
The native client must not construct authoritative totals or bypass this endpoint
